title: The Game
description:
S6 E14 — Photo-Shoot Fresh
Can Chardonnay walk down the aisle without a hitch? Will Tasha find out who her baby's father is? Will Blue and Keira work out their problems (again)? All this and more on the season 7 finale.

title: The Game
description:
S6 E15 — Psh!! I'm Good!!
Blue attempts to apologize to Keira and is spurned when he learns of a visit from a "co-worker." In an attempt to get over his frustration, he takes up Malik's offer to go out for a night on the town and join him.

title: The Game
description:
S6 E16 — A Swan Song For Rick And Tasha..
After getting back together, Blue and Keira run into a slight problem when Blue starts to believe that their relationship is contributing to his poor performance.

title: The Game
description:
S6 E17 — Miss Me A Little When I'm Gone
Malik gets into a confrontation with his ex-girlfriend's current man, and must choose between her and his current flame. Meanwhile, Blue and Keira have a revealing moment after an argument about how honest their relationship is.

title: The Game
description:
S6 E18 — In Treatment
Tasha seeks out counseling from a professional to determine where her datingproblems come from. Eventually Malik stops by, making it a group session with the mother and son duo discovering certain truths about themselves.

title: The Game
description:
S6 E19 — Extra Butter...Extra Salt..
Keira and Blue attend the red carpet premiere of Baggers together, but their happiness is short lived when Keira advises Blue to step out during the sex scene. Tasha has an emotional moment with Jason before leaving to reconnect with her father.

title: The Game
description:
S6 E20 — The Hospital Episode
Malik is rushed to the hospital after being brutally beaten by Franko. Keiraand Blue have a heart to heart while at the hospital. Jason and Chardonnay reconcile. Tasha has a very heated discussion with her father.

title: The Game
description:
S7 E1 — The Jersey Episode, Part 1
The Game is back! We pick up where season six left off —Malik is no longer able to play, Keira and Blue are still broken up and Jason Pitts is ready to live the retired life.

title: The Game
description:
S7 E2 — The Jersey Episode, Part 2
In part two of the season premiere, Jason confronts the ex-player who provided him with steroids several seasons ago. Keira'sdrunk antics lead to an argument in a bathroom stall as the actress catches Blue with his pants down (literally).

title: The Game
description:
S7 E3 — Rules of the Street
Malik is forced to enter rehab after much denial about his arm problem. Tasha finally visits a doctor and learns she's much further along in her pregnancy than she initially believed.

description:

As Jamie leaves for a lengthy performing tour, Fancy wonders how to tell him her true feelings for him.  Singers K-CI & JO JO guest star.
